root_cause.text: In `sev_ioctl_do_pek_csr`, the driver copies the PEK CSR blob to userspace using the length returned by firmware even when the PSP command fails, allowing a read beyond the kernel-allocated buffer if firmware reports a larger length due to an invalid input size.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a check `if (ret || WARN_ON_ONCE(argp->error))` before copying the blob, and the KASAN report shows a slab-out-of-bounds read during `copy_to_user` originating from `sev_ioctl_do_pek_csr`. The commit message explicitly states that a failed command with an invalid length causes copying the firmware-required number of bytes to overflow the kernel buffer.

intent_record.how: Prevents further processing, particularly copying blob data to userspace, when an error has occurred either from a prior operation (ret) or from the firmware/hardware (argp->error). This ensures proper error handling and avoids potential undefined behavior or information leakage.
